collection.title: Fiat Panda 2012 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Fiat Panda 2012 Onwards model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 15" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Push Button arm attachment. We also have rear blade for this Panda, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.

image.alt: Fiat Panda 2012 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
